mstts:express-as.prosody: Have you ever paused to wonder why the choices you make sometimes don’t quite add up, even when you think you’re being completely logical? It turns out, our everyday decisions are shaped by a whole world of hidden influences—ones we hardly notice, yet they steer us in ways we’d never expect. Together, we’re about to pull back the curtain on these subtle forces, inspired by Dan Ariely’s eye-opening book, Predictably Irrational: The Hidden Forces That Shape Our Decisions. You’ll discover how even the smartest minds fall for the same predictable patterns—like being drawn to the magic of a “free” offer, or letting social pressures nudge us off track. We’ll walk through real experiments and surprising stories that reveal what’s really going on beneath the surface, from the reasons we procrastinate to the ways expectations color our experiences. As we explore these fascinating examples together, you’ll start to see just how much our behavior is driven by invisible habits and biases—far more than pure logic ever could. So, get ready for a journey that just might change the way you see your own choices, and open up a whole new curiosity about what truly shapes the way we all think and act.
